name: yjeek-website
description: Yjeek website — React (frontend) + Node/Express/MongoDB (backend) in one repo

scripts.dev:backend: node api.js && npm run dev -w backend
scripts.dev:frontend: node api.js && npm run dev -w frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.start: node api.js && npm run start -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
